scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Depends on: Phase 0 exit (ledger, idempotent write and tracing proven in production)." Phase 6: "You can't choose a fixer until you can measure one."
scores.rationale: Each phase names explicit dependencies and a proven exit check, and the order runs substrate, defenses, retrieval, model access, memory, sandbox, orchestration, routing, feedback.

scores.evidence: "A real label in production gets the comment within 2 min." plus one trace covering webhook → queue → model → GitHub write.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production slice with deploy, infrastructure, canary and kill switch, before any features.

scores.evidence: "Allow auto-merge for one class of change ... after ≥50 PRs with ≥95% merged unedited, no reverts in 30 days, and maintainer sign-off."
scores.rationale: The tradeoff table gives a default and a concrete flip condition for every irreversible decision, and it says which ones are fixed from day one.

scores.evidence: "Action contract ... Widest blast radius: every capability goes through it." and "Widest, because one poisoned memory corrupts every later run."
scores.rationale: Tasks within each phase are explicitly ordered with the widest-impact item first and leaf items last.

scores.evidence: Cross-cutting table Security column: Phase 0 "Only `issues: write` and `metadata: read`; webhook signature check; keys in secret manager"; also P1–P8.
scores.rationale: Concrete security measures appear in every phase, starting with the skeleton.

scores.evidence: "One trace from webhook to GitHub write; tokens and cost per run; alerts; hourly canary; golden-set score on every deploy"
scores.rationale: Phase 0 has full observability, and every later phase adds specific metrics.

scores.evidence: "OpenTofu infrastructure; signed, digest-pinned image; prompt hash and model snapshot saved per run"
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete reproducibility measures, such as pinned versions, frozen eval sets, and index versions.

scores.evidence: "Save before returning 202; drop duplicate deliveries; repeatable writes with a hidden marker; reconciler; ignore own events; kill switch"
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete failure handling, from idempotency and the reconciler in Phase 0 to checkpoints and automatic demotion later.

scores.evidence: "Defenses and budgets are stubbed in Phase 0 and completed in Phase 1, before any capability."
scores.rationale: The order is defenses, budgets and approval, then retrieval (P2), model access (P3), memory (P4), orchestration (P6), routing (P7), and feedback (P8), with concrete exit checks.

scores.evidence: "Embedding search for code. When text and symbol search miss the real fix's files in more than 30% of localization tasks."
scores.rationale: The deferred list is explicit, and each item has a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: An excellent, thorough plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content; the only visible quirk is that Phase 5 runs in parallel with Phases 2–4, and the plan handles that with an explicit dependency graph.
